g.text: Raw losses are not comparable across data mixes: v1 / LDM-restart / q35 train on flag-decon-v1 (tokenizer-256k), v3+ on v8ml / opt81 (agent tokenizer), which reads ~0.09–0.11 lower at equal tokens. The recalibrated points (docs/loss_extrapolation) put v4 on q35's mix: −0.168 at 1.07T.
